tei:div.tei:p: ༈ oṃ swasti/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag rdor gtum po che/ /padma 'byung gnas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku/ /phung byed shāntiṃ garbha nus pa'i bdag /rom bu gu ya tsant+ra grub pa'i dbang / /rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po drag sngags bdag /slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje chos kyi rgyal/ /bal po ba su dha ra gsang sngags bdag /grub chen sangs rgyas ye shes bstan pa'i srog /dge bshes drang nga kun grags mkhas pa'i dbang / /swa'i bandhe 'bum grags chos kyi rgyal/ /skyo'i bandhe'i mthu chen dgra bgegs sgrol/ /rje btsun mdo sde seng ge mkhas btsun dbang / /mtshungs med rong pa rga lo mkhas grub che/ /bla ma sre'u chung ba mkhas pa'i dbang / /'jam dpa'i dbyangs dngos rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang 'gro ba'i mgon/ /dbon chen chos skyong mtshan can chos kyi bdag /rje btsun blo gsal rgya mtsho slob bshad bdag /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen/ /rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gsang sngags bdag /brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang mkhas btsun che/ /nam mkha' sangs rgyas nyams dang rtogs pa'i bdag /nam mkha' dpal bzang byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dam chos bsam 'grub bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs snyigs dus rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs dang bcom ldan 'das/ /gsang bdag la sogs yi dam lha tshogs dang / /mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /legs ldan stag gzhon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas/ /srung skyob sba dang 'go ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i tshogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams ye shes tshogs/

/byang phyogs la sogs shes bya'i chos rnams kun/ /thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel ste/ /mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin sa thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang sangs rgyas lhun grub kyis bskul nas/ a wa dhu ti pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bgyis pa'o/ /bkra shis dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang bcas bzhugs so/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
